title: Key word transformations 1
summary_es: Seis frases: estilo indirecto, modales de deducción, pasiva, «wish» y «such».

items.original: I haven't been to the cinema for six months.
items.after: to the cinema was six months ago.
items.explanation_es: «I haven't… for six months» = «the last time I went was six months ago». Al fijar un momento pasado, el verbo pasa a past simple.

items.original: "You should see a doctor," Maria told me.
items.explanation_es: Estilo indirecto de un consejo: advise + persona + to + infinitivo.

items.original: It's possible that Tom missed the bus.
items.explanation_es: Posibilidad sobre el pasado: might + have + participio.

items.original: The exam was so difficult that nobody finished it.
items.explanation_es: So + adjetivo = such + a/an + adjetivo + nombre. Con un nombre contable en singular no se puede omitir el artículo.

items.original: I regret not studying harder at school.
items.explanation_es: Arrepentimiento sobre el pasado: wish + past perfect.

items.original: They are building a new bridge across the river.
items.explanation_es: Pasiva del presente continuo: is/are + being + participio.
